comment: Identifiers replaced when cutting the public branch. Order matters: longer,
more specific patterns run before the bare project names they contain.
`find` is a JavaScript regex source, applied with flags 'g' (plus 'i' when
`ignoreCase` is true). Every entry carries the reason it exists, so adding one
is a deliberate act recorded in a file — the same discipline as
The cut FAILS if any `find` still matches after scrubbing, so an entry that
stops working is loud rather than silent.
Consumer names are matched case-insensitively: the lowercase form turns up in file names (example-backend) and database identifiers (appdb_user), which the first scripted cut left behind.
